text:
Aisha (CS): Heads up — onboarding webhook retries are failing for a subset of trial tenants (we've seen ~1200 failed attempts across 52 tenants since 09:12 UTC). I'm preparing outbound comms, want alignment on root cause + mitigation + feedback capture before we send.
Ravi (Eng): Root cause looks like a regression in the async retry backoff we shipped yesterday. Some clients hit 429/timeout loops. Working on a hotfix to tighten backoff and circuit-break after 3 attempts.
Liam (Solutions): Can we get the exact list of affected tenants (IDs) and whether any are flagged as high-touch / renewal-risk? Need to tailor comms.
Harper (Support): We're already seeing increased ticket volume. I've created a triage label `onboard-webhook-fail` and added initial tickets for 8 high-touch accounts. Will attach links.
ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2024-0921-ONBHOOK (severity: medium) — owners: eng-oncall, cs-ops.
Aisha (CS): Draft outbound I'm proposing (short):

"Hi <Account Owner>,
We experienced transient onboarding webhook failures that may have delayed import of your initial data. Our engineers identified the issue and deployed a mitigation; most customers are restored. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with an RCA and any credits if impacted. If this affected your onboarding timeline or you need help, reply here and we'll prioritize a support session. — Aisha, Customer Success"

Aisha (CS): Can ppl +1 on tone and confirm we should include an optional 15-min enablement offer as mitigation?
Maeve (CS Manager): +1 on tone. Please include the 15-min enablement slot for high-touch customers only — we'll surface as `we can schedule a prioritized onboarding session`. Also mark any high renewal risk accounts so AMs can escalate.
Ravi (Eng): Hotfix rolled to canary at 09:42 UTC; added circuit-break and backoff patch. Canary logs show retries dropping from avg 7 -> 2. Pushing to prod in 10m if metrics stay stable.
Harper (Support): I'll batch-send a CS-only note to affected AMs with the ticket links and sample customer message. Can we add a short one-question survey in the follow-up: "Was your onboarding delayed? (Yes/No)" so CS can quickly tag impacts?
Liam (Solutions): Suggestion: include a tiny feedback link pointing to `https://redwood.ai/s/1q-onboard-impact` and add UTM so we can track response by account. Keep survey single question + optional comments.
Aisha (CS): Good — I'll include the survey link and schedule outbound at 10:05 UTC (10m after prod push). Harper please confirm you can have AM batch note ready by 10:00.
Harper (Support): Confirmed. I'll also add a template for AMs to log renewal risk if customer answers Yes and mentions timeline impact.
Ravi (Eng): Prod push started 09:53 UTC. Monitoring dashboard: error-rate down 88% in last 5m. Will update when rollback/forward completes.
ops-bot: Deployment: rollout to prod started by Ravi (Eng) — 09:53 UTC.
Aisha (CS): Final checklist before outbound: 1) list of affected tenant IDs from eng (Ravi) 2) AM batch note (Harper) 3) outbound email + survey link (Aisha) 4) renewal-risk tagging instructions (Maeve). Assigning owners in thread.
Ravi (Eng): Sending CSV of tenant IDs to this thread now.
Aisha (CS): Received CSV, thanks. I'll send the customer note at 10:06 UTC and post a copy here after send. Thanks everyone — we'll follow up with a short RCA and a proposed credit offer if we confirm onboarding regressions per account. :thumbsup:
Maeve (CS Manager): Please include a remediation timeline in the RCA (what changed, when it was deployed, how we prevent recurrence).
Aisha (CS): Will do.
